This SYNOPSIS is inclusive of the following solicitations:

FA8556-25-R-0015 (Proven Vendors Bid B)

FA8556-25-R-0016 (Unproven Vendors Bid A)

This notice serves as a SYNOPSIS for procurement of the Wing and Fin Subassemblies which are subcomponents of the AIM-120X, and CATM-120X series of Advanced Medium Range Air to Air Missile (AMRAAM). This acquisition is contemplated as a Lowest Price, Technically Acceptable Source Selection Full and Open Competition with a Small Business Set-Aside between proven and unproven vendors.
 

1420    01-396-0339    Wing Assembly, Guided Missile    G601897    PT44
1420    01-397-0140    Fin, Guided Missile Assembly    G601895    
1420    01-364-8445    Fin, (AIM120/B)    3820431-101    
1420    01-332-5347    Wing, (AIM/CATM120/B)    3820402-101    
6920    01-295-3826    Fin, Missile-LT/CCM    7038180(-1)    PY96
6920    01-422-6767    Fin Assy, CATM P3I    7006031-1    XY59
 

The fulfillment of the supplies listed above requires initial investment, first article testing, and an extended period of preparation for manufacture and production.

All responsible sources may submit a capability statement which shall be considered by the Government. Any capability statement will need to demonstrate how the source can provide each of the required Wings and Fins subassemblies without substantial duplication of costs. Technical Data Package (TDP) will become available upon solicitation release.

_______________________________________________________________________________________________________

Amendment 1

This synopsis hereby removes the acqusition strategy of a dual solicitation for this requirement. All language and references related to a dual solicitation or separate competitive track is hereby rescinded.

The upcoming solicitation will now follow a single, inclusive process designed to encourage broad participation from all capable vendors. The updated single solicitation number is now FA8556-26-R-B013 and will be released in due time.

This synospsis also hereby amends to incorporate detailed drawings of the Advanced-Medium-Range-Air-to-Air Missile (AMRAAM) wings and fins. This update is intended to foster a more competitive playing field for all potential offerors. Furthermore, all waiver submissions to allow for a classification to be a proven source must be received by the Government no later than ten (10) calendar days after the issuance of the final solicitation.
